title: Multi-Stage Progressive Image Restoration
grouping: Three horizontal rows labelled 'Stage 1', 'Stage 2', 'Stage 3' at their top left, stacked with stage 1 at the bottom and stage 3 at the top. The only container is a grey rounded box around the last stage's block chain (named 'ORSNet' below it). A legend box in the lower-right corner names the three proposed modules by their abbreviations.
shapes_depth: The degraded input is re-shown at the start of every row as a photo thumbnail cut into fewer patches - four quadrants in stage 1, two halves in stage 2, whole in stage 3 - with each patch outlined in its own colour (orange, red, yellow, blue); the restored outputs X1-X3 are thumbnails with coloured borders at the row ends. Encoder-decoders are pairs of grey trapezoids facing each other with small coloured 3-D cuboids between them labelled 'cat'. Conv is a small upright orange box, CAB a pale-mint upright box, SAM a saturated green box. Cross-stage links rise upward: solid green lines from each SAM and dashed magenta arrows between the encoder-decoders, against black data lines.
proposed_highlight: The proposed modules are in the legend and get the only saturated fills (green SAM, orange ORB); the cross-stage flows they create are the only coloured lines.
lesson: Stack the stages bottom to top and re-show the input at each stage as a thumbnail cut into fewer patches (quadrants, halves, whole) with coloured patch borders, so the coarse-to-fine progression is drawn on the image itself.
notes: Venue from Semantic Scholar. The figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the whole raster.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Three horizontal stage rows stacked with Stage 1 at the bottom and Stage 3 at the top, each starting from a degraded image on the left and ending in a restored image on the right, with a legend box for ORB/SAM/CAB in the bottom-right.
insights.data: Inputs are real rainy car photos split into 4 patches (Stage 1), 2 patches (Stage 2) and whole (Stage 3) with coloured borders; U-Nets are grey trapezoid pairs with small 3D coloured feature cubes labelled 'cat'.
insights.emphasis: Repeated stage-specific modules use saturated fills (orange Conv, green SAM, yellow ORB in a grey ORSNet box) and the cross-stage connections are distinct colours: green solid arrows from SAM to the next stage and magenta dotted arrows between U-Net encoders/decoders.
insights.flow: Each stage reads left to right; information climbs upward between stages via green SAM-output arrows and magenta dotted feature links, so the overall progression runs bottom to top.
insights.avoid: Bottom-to-top stage ordering against top-down reading, plus many crossing coloured inter-stage lines, makes the cross-stage wiring hard to follow.

arrangement.units: one unboxed horizontal lane per stage, labelled 'Stage 1/2/3' at its left; Stage 3's ORB chain is enclosed in a grey ORSNet box
arrangement.inputs_as: real degraded photos, split into patches differently per stage
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; restored outputs at the right of each lane
arrangement.shared: the same degraded image enters every lane; SAM outputs pass up between lanes
